theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (u e : Euclid P) (s : ℝ) (γ : ℝ → Euclid P), ContDiffOn ℝ 1 γ (Ioo (-s) s) → (∀ α ∈ Ioo (-s) s, ‖γ α‖ = 1 ∧ 0 < inner ℝ (γ α) u ∧ Real.arctan (inner ℝ (γ α) e / inner ℝ (γ α) u) = α) → ∀ α ∈ Ioo (-s) s, inner ℝ (γ α) (deriv γ α) = 0 ∧ inner ℝ (γ α) u * inner ℝ (deriv γ α) e - inner ℝ (γ α) e * inner ℝ (deriv γ α) u = inner ℝ (γ α) u ^ 2 + inner ℝ (γ α) e ^ 2 ∧ deriv γ α ≠ 0
